method: Original character source corrections remapped by exact video/frame; local Aseprite blade repairs and exterior matte recorded separately. High root extraction is independent of artwork correction.
source: Selected original video RGB at 512x384, before any edits

v21_blade_repair.scope: Only rotating thin blade beyond the guard; fill continuous steel and remove detached fringe, preserving hands and all body pixels.

v21_edge_pass.scope: One-pixel exterior green spill only on new high/mid recovery source poses; original interior colors and face untouched

v22_edge_pass.scope: One-pixel exterior green spill only on new high body-drive source poses; original interior colors and face untouched

v23_edge_pass.scope: Exterior green spill on new high/mid recovery and reviewed detached background specks of at most eight pixels in high frames 54-62; original interior colors and face untouched

v24_blade_pass.method: Rigid nearest-neighbour sampling of the original idle steel; per-pose guard attachment; source hands, body and head occlude the blade. Middle foreshortening follows a smooth 93-75-110 pixel projected arc; edge-on width opens smoothly.

v27_stability_pass.method: Complete original-character recovery poses with idle-steel repair, no upper/lower pose split or per-frame recentering.
